summary: Westmoreland County steel Aermotor tower; sources differ on its build and move dates (1935, 1936, 1924/1938); removed in 1974; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1974, according to the register; no source describes the site today.

events.note: Register date for the steel Aermotor tower. The 1936 newspaper item and the Kecksburg register entry give other dates.
March 1936 newspaper item: work started on a new tower at Ridge Chapel, a mile east of Kecksburg; demolition of the Kecksburg tower to begin soon; new tower planned at 80 feet.
Richard Johnson of Kingston named as the towerman in the 1936 item.
Kecksburg register entry: that steel Aermotor tower was moved in 1938 and renamed St. Boniface. The same entry gives a 1924 build year.
Register says the tower was removed in 1974.

notes_for_editor: Sources conflict on build and move, and the story reports all three without choosing. (a) Saint Boniface register entry (US 493, PA 322): built 1935, moved from Kecksburg, removed 1974. (b) Kecksburg register entry (US 337, PA 166): built 1924, moved 1938, renamed St. Boniface. (c) March 1936 Connellsville Daily Courier item, quoted on the Weebly page: new 80-ft tower at Ridge Chapel one mile east of Kecksburg, Kecksburg tower to be demolished. The Kecksburg tower (US 337) is not in data/towers/pa and may need its own record and a link. Fact-check 2026-10-10: height_m (24.4 m, the 80 ft planned in 1936) was removed from facts. It is a planned height for the new Ridge Chapel tower, not a measured or register height for this tower. The Ridge Chapel location is not checked against the record's coordinates; the Kecksburg register entry gives none. The 2022 book (Warren D. Murrman, O.S.B., Archabbey Publications, Latrobe) is catalogued by the Mid-Atlantic Karst Conservancy library; its text was not read, so the citation supports only its title and date. The 1936 original was not read; the quote comes via the Weebly page. No staffing beyond the 1936 towerman, fire or access information found. No photos found. Ownership and current condition not established.
